args.description: See what the notes command does
Save each line as a note
Find the notes with no tag given

args.command:
notes tag shop > /tmp/shop.json && node - <<'EOF'
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'

const texts = (JSON.parse(readFileSync('/tmp/shop.json', 'utf8')) as { text: string }[]).map(note => note.text)
writeFileSync('/tau/out/report.txt', texts.join('\n') + '\n')
console.log(JSON.stringify(texts))
EOF
args.description: Write the shop notes to the report

final: Saved the three notes, and wrote the two tagged shop to /tau/out/report.txt.
